researchDraft.querySummary: Independent scan of nine evidence-bearing domain lanes from the 2026-09-29 dossier: macro/finance (UK grid investment vehicle, diesel price and export-ban shock, AI labour policy, Apple patent ruling, insurance retreat), industry/trade (US affordability politics, Nvidia security platform plus buyback), energy/resources (via diesel and offshore wind records), health/science (Starship orbital milestone, gene-edited bananas, Florida dengue emergency, pandemic treaty weakening, NHS data breach), climate/environment (Trump clean-car rollback, Alito recusal, atrazine contamination, heat-pump surge, Kelvin wave), demographics/society (Burnham social-care plan, Rayner homelessness powers, GP capacity, abortion salience), institutions/culture (Sydney data centre scrapped, French school protests, South Africa femicide), and geopolitics/security (Yemen front line, Seoul–Kyiv POW row, Iranian and Turkish speech prosecutions). Only the SpaceX Starship pair is deterministically corroborated at headline level; most candidates below rest on multiple unpaired records within a domain that independently describe the same underlying event or decision, and are marked accordingly. No candidate was built where a second independent clickable source could not be verified.

en.title: SpaceX's Starship reaches orbit for the first time, ending in a fiery splashdown
en.coreFact: SpaceX's Starship circled Earth for the first time, a milestone cheered at the Texas site, though the flight also involved an engine failure and ended in a fireball during splashdown.
en.whyItMatters: Reaching orbit with a fully reusable super-heavy vehicle is the step that determines whether very large payloads per launch become routine; the engine failure and destructive splashdown show the milestone is progress in an unfinished test campaign rather than a settled capability.
en.processMatchReason: No existing world process matches this; the candidate list covers AI infrastructure, energy security, semiconductor capacity and technology control, none of which describes launch-vehicle reusability. suggestedProcessId is therefore null.

zh.title: SpaceX星舰首次进入轨道，最终以火球式溅落收场
zh.coreFact: SpaceX的星舰首次绕地球飞行，在得州发射场引发欢呼，但本次飞行还出现发动机故障，并以溅落火球结束。
zh.whyItMatters: 一型完全可重复使用的超重型运载器进入轨道，决定了单次超大规模载荷发射能否成为常态；发动机故障和破坏性溅落表明这是未完成测试进程中的进展，而非已确立的能力。
zh.processMatchReason: 现有世界进程均不匹配；候选清单涵盖AI基础设施、能源安全、半导体产能与技术管制，没有描述运载器可重复使用的进程，因此suggestedProcessId为空。

en.title: Warning that more UK homes will become uninsurable because of flood risk
en.coreFact: A warning has been issued that more homes will become uninsurable due to flood risk, published the same day as separate reporting on a community confronting PFAS chemical pollution.
en.whyItMatters: When flood exposure moves properties out of the insurable pool, the loss lands on mortgage lenders, local government and household balance sheets rather than on insurers alone, converting a physical hazard into a durable asset-value and public-finance problem.
en.processMatchReason: No existing world process covers climate adaptation or insurance retreat; the processes listed concern energy, AI, semiconductors and technology control, so suggestedProcessId is null.

zh.title: 警告称更多英国住宅将因洪水风险而无法投保
zh.coreFact: 有警告指出，更多住宅将因洪水风险而无法投保；同日另有报道讲述一个社区直面PFAS化学污染的经历。
zh.whyItMatters: 当洪水风险把房产挤出可投保范围时，损失将落在抵押贷款机构、地方政府和家庭资产负债表上，而不仅是保险公司，从而把物理风险转化为持久的资产价值与公共财政问题。
zh.processMatchReason: 现有世界进程均不涵盖气候适应或保险退出；所列进程涉及能源、AI、半导体与技术管制，因此suggestedProcessId为空。

en.title: Burnham to fight the next election with an NHS-style social care service
en.coreFact: Andy Burnham is to fight the next election with a plan for an NHS-style care service, while the architect of a previous reform, Dilnot, said an NHS-style social care system could take decades, and Rayner is granting councils new homelessness duties to drive social housing.
en.whyItMatters: Elevating social care to an NHS-style entitlement reframes ageing-related care as core national infrastructure rather than a means-tested residual, but the decades-long timeline and the parallel housing push show the binding constraints are workforce and capital, not political commitment alone.
en.processMatchReason: No existing world process covers care, ageing or housing provision; the listed processes are energy, AI, semiconductor and technology-control related, so suggestedProcessId is null.

zh.title: 伯纳姆将以NHS式社会照护服务方案投入下届大选
zh.coreFact: 安迪·伯纳姆将以建立NHS式照护服务的方案投入下届大选；此前改革的设计者迪尔诺特表示，NHS式社会照护体系可能需要数十年才能建成；同时雷纳正赋予地方议会新的无家可归者职责，以推动社会住房建设。
zh.whyItMatters: 把社会照护提升为NHS式的普遍权利，将老龄化相关照护重新定义为国家核心基础设施，而非需经济状况审查的残余服务；但数十年的时间表以及并行的住房推进表明，真正的约束是人力和资本，而不仅是政治承诺。
zh.processMatchReason: 现有世界进程均不涵盖照护、老龄化或住房供给；所列进程与能源、AI、半导体及技术管制相关，因此suggestedProcessId为空。

en.title: Burnham to unveil a public body to invest in the electricity grid
en.coreFact: Andy Burnham is set to unveil a public body dedicated to investing in the electricity grid, a shift toward greater public control of energy infrastructure.
en.whyItMatters: Directing public capital into network capacity changes who bears grid-build risk and how quickly connections for industry, electrified heating and data loads arrive, but it also adds fiscal and political exposure to a sector whose weakness has already fed household energy-price anger.
en.processMatchReason: The candidate is a direct instance of energy access being built as strategic capacity, matching the energy-security process, though the instrument is public finance rather than generation technology.

zh.title: 伯纳姆将公布投资电网的公共机构
zh.coreFact: 安迪·伯纳姆将公布一个专门投资电网的公共机构，这标志着能源基础设施向更大程度的公共控制转变。
zh.whyItMatters: 将公共资本直接投入网络容量，改变了谁承担电网建设风险，也改变了工业、电气化供暖和数据负载接入的速度；但这同时使该行业增加财政与政治敞口，而该行业的薄弱已经引发家庭能源价格的不满。
zh.processMatchReason: 该候选是能源获取被建设为战略能力的直接实例，与能源安全进程匹配，尽管工具是公共财政而非发电技术。
